qs.q: Which of the following is NOT measured in a basic metabolic panel (BMP)?
qs.e: A BMP typically includes glucose, electrolytes (Na+, K+, Cl-, CO2), BUN, and creatinine. Bilirubin is part of liver function tests, not the BMP.
